---
id: komodo-dragon
title: Komodo dragon
---
The Komodo dragon (*Varanus komodoensis*) is the largest living lizard,
confined to a few Indonesian islands. It scavenges and also kills deer
and pigs with a bite that combines venom and bacteria. A forked tongue
samples scent on a vomeronasal organ. Juveniles climb; adults dominate
carcasses. Conservation fences and tourism shape the remaining range.
